what: A square photo window at the center of a pinned stage inside a long panel widens, with no curve, to screen width (100vw) × band height (min(600px, 80vh)) during .35~.65 of the panel’s pass through the screen (0 when its top touches the screen bottom → 1 when its bottom passes the screen top), and its 12px corners go to 0 — the image inside is centered at its fully open size from the start, so it doesn’t grow but is only revealed. A brand introduction where the center photo among the scattered small photos becomes a band leading into the next section

options.from: Progress at which expansion starts, default .35
options.--fx-size: Initial square side (css), default 31.33vw — Brand C is 4 cells + 4 gaps
options.--fx-band: Height when fully open (css), default min(600px, 80vh)
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Fixed stage inside the panel (child) — sticky at screen height
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Expanding photo window (child of the stage). The first child inside is the image

from.where: index.html .ff-story — original .page-top__story__sticky__imageBox .p-image.is-main (--thisProgressBottom .35~.65, 4-cell square → 100vw × min(40rem, 80vh), corner var(--radius) → 0)

note: The stage height is the screen height, so the panel must be taller than the screen to stay stuck while it widens. The original puts an empty section as tall as the band at the end of the panel, so the fully opened band stays in place as the page moves on to the next section
